# id: # The canonical ABI invariant registry (traceability: model <-> invariant <-> test <-> gate).
# strength ladder: rocq-unbounded > tlaps-unbounded > apalache-inductive > verus > smt-dual > tlc-bounded > test-pinned.
#   - tlc-bounded rows carry their upgrade rung in the manifest notes; once an upgrade is
#     attempted, a failed attempt must be recorded in docs/verification/FINDINGS_LEDGER.md

#     unbounded content (the note in the law column must say why).

gate: verify-formal.sh tla + cargo test --features binding-integration-tests --test abi_resource_lifecycle_correspondence

gate: verify-formal.sh tla + cargo test --features binding-integration-tests --test abi_resource_lifecycle_correspondence
